gen-gf-phudu-gf-hanuman: Phudu draws bold, ballpoint-plain lines with generous openings on every curve, a display voice that never wavers in thickness. Hanuman, a refined text serif with a high-waisted lowercase, supplies the traditional counterweight.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-kadwa: Kadwa reads classic and editorial, with a larger-than-usual x-height. Across many lines its open-ended curves keep moving smoothly, while Phudu holds a bold, pressure-free line above without any brush-like swelling.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-noticia-text: Chunky tubes, literary manners: Phudu holds a constant weight while Noticia Text gives each curve a big visible entrance. Phudu is built to announce; Noticia Text is built to be read.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-pridi: Stroke ends cut from one ribbon give Phudu its bold, distinctive stamp. Pridi, a refined serif with generous space between curve ends and stems, keeps extended reading easy and unhurried.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-scope-one: Phudu keeps a tube-like thickness through every single bend. Scope One, a traditional serif of big x-height and stubby ascenders, feels sturdy and refined beside that bold display voice.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-slabo-13px: Phudu is bold and distinctive, drawn with plain, pressure-free lines. Slabo 13px, a bookish serif with large open counters, lets a whole page of text read clearly, its rounded letters plainly open.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified is the first word for Suwannaphum, a serif whose high x-height stands like a squared-off woodblock letter. And Phudu, the display heading, stays moderate in lowercase height and bold in manner.
gen-gf-piedra-fs-rowan: Bold Piedra pinches the mouth of every curve almost shut. Rowan, a literary classic serif with generous curve openings, softens that closed look, though it isn't built for lengthy paragraphs.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-epunda-slab: Pixelify Sans holds one monoline stroke from start to finish, bold and expressive. Epunda Slab, a dignified text serif with a visibly gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, gives the heading a classic counterweight.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One, a literary text serif built on a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, brings dignity to continuous text. Pixelify Sans is made to shout; Fauna One is made to settle in.
